item.title: Rubio Hosts Israel and Lebanon for Rare Meeting Shadowed by U.S.-Iran War
item.summary: The gathering ended with encouraging words, even as Israel continued to refuse to halt its military campaign against Iran-backed Hezbollah in Lebanon.

item.title: Trump’s Blockade Risks Upending an Emerging Détente With China
item.summary: In a thinly veiled critique of the war in Iran, China’s leader said the world could not risk reverting “to the law of the jungle.”

item.title: Israel’s Spy Chief Addresses Criticism About the War With Iran
item.summary: The Mossad head said Israel’s mission would not be complete until the Iranian regime was replaced, after criticism that the war has left Iran’s theocratic government in place.

item.title: Italy Suspends Defense Pact With Israel, Further Straining Ties
item.summary: The move by Italy, once considered a strong ally of Israel, reflected growing anger over Israeli aggression in the Middle East. President Trump criticized Italy’s stance on the war.

item.title: China Offers Veiled Criticism of U.S. as Iran War Threatens Oil Imports
item.summary: China’s leader, Xi Jinping, said that the world cannot risk reverting “to the law of the jungle.” Beijing has taken a more active role diplomatically as the crisis in the Strait of Hormuz persists.

item.title: Middle East War Will Slow Global Economic Growth, I.M.F. Warns
item.summary: The conflict could also fuel another bout of inflation, according to the International Monetary Fund.

item.title: State of U.S. Blockade Is Unclear as Some Ships Transit Strait of Hormuz
item.summary: Ship-tracking data showed that several vessels, including some that had been docked at Iranian ports, had moved through the strait as the U.S. military began its blockade.

item.title: Ex-Student Wounds 16 in High School Shooting in Turkey
item.summary: Officials said the teenage attacker killed himself when cornered by the police. The authorities are investigating possible motives.

item.title: As Bahrain Cracked Down Amid War, a Death in Custody Sparked Outrage
item.summary: The body of a man accused of spying for Iran, Mohammed al-Mousawi, showed signs of torture, witnesses said. The U.N. has called for an investigation.

item.title: As War Chills Economy, Dubai’s Most Vulnerable Bear the Cost
item.summary: Migrant workers in the United Arab Emirates, whose hospitality industry has been hit hard by the war with Iran, are facing furloughs, pay cuts and even repatriation.
